fw.label: Who is it for
fw.title:
Who needs
Mess&Anger
fw.desc: A messenger without compromises — for those who genuinely care.
fw.c1pain: «My sources fear being traced through metadata»
fw.c1sol: P2P with no servers. No metadata to seize. Stealth mode hides timestamps.
fw.c2pain: «Telegram is blocked. VPN is too visible»
fw.c2sol: 5 anti-censorship levels: WebRTC → WebSocket → MTProto → Domain Fronting → Auto.
fw.c3pain: «I do not want to trust a black box»

mesh.label: Unique feature
mesh.title: Mesh Compass — Node Radar
mesh.desc: The only messenger with a visual radar of nearby relay nodes. Works without internet, cellular or power grid — up to 50 km range.
mesh.f1d: Real-time Canvas radar shows bearing and distance to each P2P node. Node pulses when you get within 500m range.
mesh.f2d: Exact GPS → ~100m → ~1km → city only. You control how precisely other nodes know your position.
mesh.f3d: Every 5 minutes publishMeshBeacon() broadcasts your obfuscated coordinates via DHT. Others find you with no central server.
mesh.f4d: Each relay has a trust score 0–1. Filter out unknown or suspicious nodes — the first such mechanism in mesh messengers.
mesh.f5d: X25519 + ML-KEM-768 + Signal Double Ratchet on every hop. Mesh routing does not sacrifice encryption.
max.label: Mess&Anger vs MAX
max.title: Why not MAX by VK
max.desc: MAX is pre-installed on every smartphone sold in Russia since 2025. We compare without politics — only architecture and facts.
max.r1b: Absent in personal and group chats
max.r6b: Built-in — real identity linked to system
max.r8b: VK servers in Russia — cloud storage
max.r11b: Centralized — blocked by a single decision
max.r14b: Mandatory by law since Sept 2025 — all devices in Russia
max.law_p1: Since September 2025 MAX is pre-installed on all smartphones in Russia. Not just convenience — a legislative infrastructure decision.
max.law_p2: Under the Yarovaya Package (FZ-374), messengers must store and provide communications to the FSB without court order. MAX as a Russian VK service is fully subject to this.
max.law_p3: Gosuslugi integration means every account is tied to passport data. Anonymity is architecturally excluded.
max.dc1_7: Bug Bounty up to 5M RUB — launched July 2025
max.dc2_1: No servers — no point of data seizure
max.dc2_2: Messages encrypted before sending, decrypted only at recipient
max.dc2_3: No phone number or passport linkage
max.dc2_4: E2E on all chats by default, not just secret ones
max.dc2_5: Open code — anyone can verify absence of backdoors
max.dc2_6: Mesh mode: works without internet and Russian servers
max.dc2_7: External audit planned after public release
mod.label: Channel moderation
mod.title:
Decentralized
content protection
mod.desc: No central administrator. The community decides what is acceptable — through cryptographically verified reports and an exponential decay algorithm.
mod.s1d: Account older than 7 days, more than 10 messages, rate-limit not exceeded (5/hour, 20/day), 24h cooldown on re-reporting the same channel.
mod.s2d: Scans channel name, description and last 20 posts. Report is counted only if ContentModerationService finds a match. Otherwise weight=0.
mod.s3d: weight = e^(−days/45). Flags older than 30 days expire. Sum of weights over a sliding window determines status.
mod.s4d: Creator sees status and complaint categories (no names). Can submit an appeal. P2P network moderator decides; on ban removal all flags are cleared.
mod.flagged_action: Hidden from search and public lists. Creator receives notification.
mod.restricted_action: New posts prohibited. Existing content visible to subscribers.
mod.appeal_desc: Creator sees status and complaint categories without reporter names. Appeal button available from ChannelAdminPanel → Moderation.
morse.label: Morse code
morse.title:
Covert message
transmission
morse.desc: The only messenger with built-in Morse code. Encode text with one button — automatic detection on the recipient's side.
morse.f1d: Press the ●●● button to the right of the input field — Morse mode activates. Send the message — text is automatically encoded.
morse.f2d: The app detects Morse messages automatically. A yellow SOS badge appears on the bubble. One tap — full decoding.
morse.f3d: A Morse message looks like dots and dashes. Even if someone glances at your screen — the content is unreadable without decoding.
morse.f4d: Latin letters, digits, 18 punctuation marks. Space encoded as /. Cyrillic and emoji pass through as-is.
morse.f5d: Morse text is plain ASCII. It can be sent via any chat, email, SMS, or printed — readable everywhere.

cmp.label: Comparison
cmp.title:
Why not Telegram
or Signal?
cmp.desc: All popular messengers store your data on their servers. Mess&Anger is the only one where data lives exclusively on your device.
feat.label: Features
feat.title:
Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.
feat.p1: WebRTC creates an encrypted tunnel directly between you and your contact. No server ever sees your messages — there's nothing in between.
feat.p2: Dual encryption. ML-KEM-768 approved by NIST in 2024 — resistant to quantum computer attacks for decades ahead.
feat.p3: Identity is your cryptographic fingerprint. Add contacts via QR code, username, or nexus:// link.
feat.p4: Auto-delete after 5s/1m/1h/6h/1d/7d. Screenshot and forwarding blocked. Disappears on both devices simultaneously.
feat.p5: Text and photo stories with 24h cache. Contacts only. Screenshot protection. Zero CDN — all stored on device.
feat.p6: No Google Analytics, no hidden permissions. 0 external CDNs. Source code on GitHub — check for yourself.
list.label: Full list
list.title:

list.desc: All familiar messenger features implemented in P2P architecture. 100% Telegram feature plan complete.
sec.label: Security architecture
sec.title:
10 layers
of protection
sec.desc: Security score 8.5/10. From RFC 5869 HKDF to Tor bridges. Each layer is independent — if one is compromised, the rest hold.
sec.fpdesc: Users verify fingerprints in person or via video call to ensure no MITM attack.
sec.l3: Unique key per message. On all chats, not just secret.
sec.l6: AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 for storage at rest. 600k iterations.
stars.label: Stars Economy
stars.title:
Earn by
supporting the network
stars.desc: Stars is a local reward system. Not crypto, not blockchain. Just motivation for those who keep the network alive.
ac.label: Anti-censorship
ac.title:
Impossible
to block
ac.desc: 5 resistance levels. If one is unavailable — automatic switch. Traffic is indistinguishable from regular HTTPS for any DPI.
ac.l1d: Standard P2P. Direct encrypted tunnel with no intermediaries.
ac.l3d: Fake TLS headers, XOR, random padding, timing jitter.
ac.l4d: Via CDN. DPI sees only CDN request, not the peer.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title:
Frequently
asked questions
faq.a7: A cryptographic protocol developed by Signal. Every message is encrypted with a unique key — even if one key is compromised, all other messages stay protected. Unlike Telegram, we apply it to all chats, not just 'secret' ones.
faq.a8: Yes — 511 automated tests pass with zero errors. Security score 8.5/10. External audit is planned as the next step after public release.
faq.q1: What if I lose my phone?
faq.a1: If you created a backup (.mess file) — restore your account on a new device. Without a backup, data is lost forever.
faq.a2: Practically impossible. Traffic is obfuscated and indistinguishable from HTTPS. If WebRTC is blocked — WebSocket tunnel activates automatically.
faq.a3: Only you and the recipient. Messages are encrypted on your device and decrypted only on the recipient's device.
faq.a4: Encryption resistant to future quantum computers. ML-KEM-768 approved by NIST in 2024.
faq.q5: How do I add a contact?
faq.a5: Scan a QR code, find by username, or get a nexus:// link. There is no central address book.
faq.a6: No. Stars is a local activity reward system. No blockchain, no market value.
